Texts_pw:
Mixes the mahjongs to
bring more matching
possibilities.

Colors the mahjongs so
they can be matched.
Texts_pw_fr:
Mélange les tuiles pour
donner plus de
possibilités.

Colore les tuiles pour
qu'elles soient
combinables.

text.txttuto:
Select two identical
tiles to remove them.
text.txttuto2:
Colored tiles can be
matched even if they
are not identical.
text.txttuto3:
You will get +10 seconds
if you make 3 consecutive
matches of the same type.

 100 coins!
